#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Native scale, discrete code, rollback and exact sidecar CPU contracts.
# No assets, model loading, CUDA, optimizer or intelligence claim.
set -euo pipefail
cd -- "$(dirname -- "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")"
source scripts/shell/tinylm_env.sh
PY="$(tinylm_python)"
export CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=""
export OMP_NUM_THREADS=2
export MKL_NUM_THREADS=2
"${PY}" -B -X utf8 scripts/runlog.py --num 108 --name P108_Stage7aW_native_scale_contract --note "CPU contracts for sign-preserving latent edits and fixed-scale native codes. Check actual TLinear requantization, no-op bytes, full prevalidation, exact rollback, sealed packets and group-matched random controls. No checkpoint/model/GPU execution or intelligence claim."
exec "${PY}" -B -X utf8 scripts/runlog.py --num 108 --name P108_Stage7aW_native_scale_contract -- "${PY}" -B -X utf8 -m unittest scripts.test_p108_native_scale scripts.test_p108_weight_space

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Repair duplicate practice prompts and the identifiable random-control fixture.
# Preserve Stage7aW failure; do not execute any model/GPU/optimizer.
set -euo pipefail
cd -- "$(dirname -- "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")"
source scripts/shell/tinylm_env.sh
PY="$(tinylm_python)"
export CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=""
export OMP_NUM_THREADS=2
export MKL_NUM_THREADS=2
"${PY}" -B -X utf8 scripts/runlog.py --num 108 --name P108_Stage7aWb_native_scale_contract --note "Preserve first CPU failure. Fresh source identity uses actual facts, distinct actor pairs, and matched controls with a proper nontrivial transition subset. All native scale/packet/rollback criteria remain unchanged. No assets or GPU."
exec "${PY}" -B -X utf8 scripts/runlog.py --num 108 --name P108_Stage7aWb_native_scale_contract -- "${PY}" -B -X utf8 -m unittest scripts.test_p108_native_scale scripts.test_p108_weight_space
